fused form with avagraha marking sandhi: namite (locative singular neuter past participle of nam, bent) + abhimate (locative singular neuter past participle of abhi-man, regarded/considered); exact paired sense in this defective-house context is uncertain
locative singular neuter noun, the locus to which the listed conditions apply

items.question: Which defective conditions of a dwelling must be recognized as grounds for appropriate action?
premises: A dwelling may be in a cut condition.
A dwelling may be in a split condition.
A dwelling may be in a destroyed condition.
A dwelling may be in a bent or otherwise regarded condition.
items.inference: When a dwelling exhibits such defective conditions, they must be recognized and treated accordingly.
uncertainties: The precise sense of the fused compound namite'bhimate in this context, especially abhimate, is not fully certain.
items.plain_english: When a house is cut, split, likewise destroyed, bent, or otherwise regarded in such a condition, this must be recognized accordingly.
